## Short Introduction

I'm a researcher who started off in biochemistry and eventually moved into mathematics. The unifying thread of my interests and research is information theory, which as I learned as an undergraduate in biochemistry, explains how information is processed and transmitted in complex systems, even -- and especially -- those found in biology. This blog explores quantitative finance, probability, information theory, AI, and complex systems.


## Qualifications

- **PhD**, Cambridge University — information theory (here is my [thesis](https://www.repository.cam.ac.uk/items/fa3aebe0-987d-44d2-a2c9-17b73cecb85a))
- **MPhil**, Cambridge University — scientific computing
- **MScRes**, Oxford University — stochastic differential equations
- **BA**, Columbia University — biochemistry
